precommit.//: Runs all pre-commit tasks related to setting up the vault prior to builds and commits: publishes the private notes' stubs, then checks that they publish only the placeholder.

publish-private.//: Publishes the private notes' stubs: the private vault's scrub.mjs empties dist/vault-private and writes a stub of each private note into dist/vault-private/content, at the path the note has in content/private/content: its title, date and tags (and `draft: true` for a draft, which the site leaves out), the placeholder text in utils/private-stub-body.txt, and its links within the site (vault:guard-private checks them), then index-tags gives each new tag a description file. dist/vault-private is committed, so CI, which never checks out the private vault, builds from the stubs (astro:vault). Without the private vault, the scrub is skipped and the committed stubs are left as they are. The scrub also edits the private notes in place (its meeting-note steps); nothing else here writes into content/ but index-tags.

commands: if [ -f private/scrub.mjs ]; then node private/scrub.mjs ../dist/vault-private utils/private-stub-body.txt; else echo 'The private vault is not checked out; leaving dist/vault-private as it is.'; fi

guard-private.//: Read-only: fails if any file in dist/vault-private, which is committed and public, is more than a private note's placeholder: only title, date and tags in its frontmatter, with `private` among the tags, and a body of exactly utils/private-stub-body.txt plus, optionally, a `## Links` list of links within the site (utils/guard-private.ts). Run by vault:precommit, the git pre-commit hook (with --staged, on what's staged) and the deploy workflow.

alias-moves.//: Gives each public note that the next commit moves, a rename or a deleted note and an added one of the same name, its old path as an alias, so its old address forwards to the new one; a moved tag description note's alias forwards the old tag's page. Edits the staged copy and the working tree's apart, so an unstaged change stays unstaged. Reports a deleted note no move accounts for, and a note that moves into the private vault at a new address, without stopping the commit (utils/alias-moves.ts). Run by the git pre-commit hook.

updated-dates.//: Stamps `updated:`, the day in UTC, into each staged public note whose content the next commit changes: its title, its description, or its body with each link reduced to what it shows, so a tag rename, an alias or a moved link target changes nothing. Edits the staged copy and the working tree's apart, so an unstaged change stays unstaged. The site takes `updated` as when the note last changed, for the sitemap's lastmod (utils/updated-dates.ts). Run by the git pre-commit hook. The `backfill` configuration stamps each public note with none from its history instead, the newest commit that changed its content, into the working tree only.

test.//: The vault's script tests, with Node's test runner.

index-tags.//: Writes a description file, content/public/tags/<tag>.md, for each tag that has none, from the tags of the public notes and the private notes' stubs in dist/vault-private. One of the two writers into content/, with the private vault's scrub.

check-links.//: Read-only: fails on any link in either vault that doesn't start from Obsidian's vault root, content/ (public/… or private/…), and name a file there by its exact path (utils/check-links.ts). Bare names, links to notes not yet written, Copilot conversations, and the links a vault's .check-links-allow lists pass. Run by hand; the private vault is checked when it is checked out.

list-non-private.//: List all markdown files in content/public without 'private' tag or description field.

_clear-copilot.//: Clean Obsidian Copilot conversations. Run by hand when wanted (`nx run vault:_clear-copilot`); it is no longer part of vault:precommit, so a commit leaves the conversations alone.
